obs: "In respect of these subsidy payments, the meaning of 'income' as used in the Corporation Excise Tax Law of 1909 is not to be distinguished from the meaning of the same word as used in the Income Tax Law of 1913 and the Revenue Act of 1916."
City of Lafayette v. Louisiana Power & Light Co.
“Section 1 of the Clayton Act defines the word ‘person’ or ‘persons’ in language identical to that of § 8 of the Sherman Act ...”
International Brotherhood of Teamsters v. Daniel
“The definition of a security in 3 (a) (10) of the Securities Exchange Act is virtually identical and, for the purposes of this case, the coverage of the two Acts may be regarded as the same.”
